title.narrative: JCLEC 2024-2027: Building Capacity for Effective and Human Rights-Based Financial Crime and Counter-Extremism Investigations

description.narrative: Contribute to the strengthening of the capacity and commitment of law enforcement agencies to counter violent extremism and uphold human rights, peace and tolerance in Indonesia.

Project on Building Capacity for Effective and Human Rights-based financial crime and Counter-Extremism Investigations aim to strengthen the effectiveness of investigative practices in Indonesia related to countering violent extremism and financial crimes, while reinforcing human rights principles and gender awareness within law enforcement investigations. The project outputs – strengthen the effectiveness of Indonesian authorities in managing AML and countering financing of violent extremism, Human Rights and gender-sensitive approach in policing on criminal investigations and protection – essential to creating a law enforcement system that is fair, accountable and inclusive. The project contributes to a stronger rule of law, increased public trust, and greater social stability. Additionally, the project demonstrates Denmark’s and Indonesia’s joint commitment to advancing the UN Global Counterterrorism Strategy and the Women, Peace and Security (WPS) agenda.
